decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 8 May 2007, the erection of single storey rear extension, with a width ranging from 3.02m to 3.63m x 3.63m in length and 2.6m in height with a 0.3m parapet wall, which adds a volume of 31.6m3 to the original building and which makes the total volume of extensions to the original house 49.75m3, as shown on drawing numbers WA7[PD]270, WA[PD]271 and WA[PD]272 received 8 May 2007, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the erection of the single storey rear extension to the house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for erection of a single storey rear extension to house
